# tools.massadas.com

> A collection of browser-only tools that run 100% locally. No data is ever sent anywhere (except where noted).

Deployed as a Cloudflare Workers static asset site.

## Tools

- [Swagger Playground](https://tools.massadas.com/swagger/): Paste or drag & drop an OpenAPI schema (JSON/YAML) to preview it with Swagger UI and see validation diagnostics.
- [Image to PDF](https://tools.massadas.com/image-to-pdf/): Drop or select images, reorder by dragging, and download as a single PDF.
- [PDF to Booklet](https://tools.massadas.com/pdf-booklet/): Upload a PDF and rearrange it into a foldable saddle-stitch booklet (2 pages per sheet) to print double-sided, fold, and staple.
- [File to Markdown](https://tools.massadas.com/file-to-markdown/): Convert PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and other documents to Markdown using Cloudflare Workers AI.
- [JSON Formatter](https://tools.massadas.com/json-formatter/): Format, validate, and syntax-highlight JSON. Minify, copy, or export as YAML.
- [Base64 Encode/Decode](https://tools.massadas.com/base64/): Encode text or files to Base64, or decode Base64 back. Full UTF-8 support.
- [JWT Decoder](https://tools.massadas.com/jwt-decoder/): Decode JWT header, payload, and check expiration status.
- [Diff Viewer](https://tools.massadas.com/diff/): Paste two texts and see a highlighted side-by-side diff.
- [Regex Tester](https://tools.massadas.com/regex/): Write regex patterns with live matching and capture group highlighting.
- [CSV Viewer](https://tools.massadas.com/csv-viewer/): Paste or drop a CSV to view as a sortable, filterable table.
- [UUID Generator](https://tools.massadas.com/uuid-generator/): Generate UUIDs (v4, v7), ULIDs, and Nanoids in bulk.
- [Cron Parser](https://tools.massadas.com/cron-parser/): Parse cron expressions to see next run times and a plain English description.
- [Color Converter](https://tools.massadas.com/color-converter/): Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, and oklch.
- [Hash Generator](https://tools.massadas.com/hash-generator/): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 hashes.
- [Image Compressor](https://tools.massadas.com/image-compressor/): Resize, compress, and convert images between JPEG, PNG, and WebP.
- [SVG Optimizer](https://tools.massadas.com/svg-optimizer/): Strip metadata and optimize SVGs to reduce file size.
- [QR Code Generator](https://tools.massadas.com/qr-code/): Generate QR codes with custom size, colors, and error correction.
- [Password Generator](https://tools.massadas.com/password-generator/): Generate secure random passwords or passphrases.
- [EXIF Stripper](https://tools.massadas.com/exif-stripper/): View image EXIF metadata and download a stripped copy.
- [PDF Tools](https://tools.massadas.com/pdf-tools/): Merge, split, reorder, rotate, and delete pages across one or multiple PDFs.
- [PDF to Images](https://tools.massadas.com/pdf-to-images/): Convert PDF pages to PNG, JPEG, or WebP at adjustable resolution; download all as a ZIP.
- [PDF Compressor](https://tools.massadas.com/pdf-compress/): Shrink PDF file size by rasterizing pages to JPEG, with quality, scale, and grayscale controls.
- [PDF to Black & White](https://tools.massadas.com/pdf-black-white/): Convert color PDFs to grayscale or pure black & white for cheaper, sharper printing.
- [Image Converter](https://tools.massadas.com/image-converter/): Convert HEIC, WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPEG, GIF, and BMP images to any format.
- [Background Remover](https://tools.massadas.com/background-remover/): Remove image backgrounds with an on-device AI model; transparent PNG output, no uploads.
- [Video Converter](https://tools.massadas.com/video-converter/): Convert video/audio to MP4, WebM, GIF, MP3, or WAV and trim clips, locally with ffmpeg.wasm.
- [Markdown Editor](https://tools.massadas.com/markdown-editor/): Live split-pane editor with formatting toolbar, GitHub-style preview, and MD/HTML/PDF export.
- [Data Converter](https://tools.massadas.com/data-converter/): Convert data between JSON, YAML, and TOML with live preview and auto-detection.
- [Timestamp Converter](https://tools.massadas.com/timestamp-converter/): Parse Unix timestamps or date strings and convert across any timezone.
- [URL Encoder/Decoder](https://tools.massadas.com/url-encoder/): Encode/decode URL components, parse URLs into editable fields, and build query strings.
- [Text Case Converter](https://tools.massadas.com/text-case/): Convert text between 12 case formats with live character, word, and reading-time stats.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://tools.massadas.com/lorem-ipsum/): Generate placeholder text and tables of fake data as JSON, CSV, SQL, or a table.
- [JSON to CSV](https://tools.massadas.com/json-csv/): Convert JSON arrays to CSV (with nested flattening) and CSV back to JSON.
- [HTML to Markdown](https://tools.massadas.com/html-markdown/): Convert between HTML and Markdown in both directions with a sanitized preview.
- [String Escape](https://tools.massadas.com/string-escape/): Escape/unescape strings across 12 formats: JSON, JS, HTML, XML, URL, SQL, CSV, Shell, and more.
- [Number Base Converter](https://tools.massadas.com/number-base/): Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, hex, and any base 2-36.
- [Text Encrypt/Decrypt](https://tools.massadas.com/text-encrypt/): Encrypt and decrypt text with AES-256-GCM (PBKDF2 password) in your browser.
- [PGP Tool](https://tools.massadas.com/pgp/): Generate PGP keypairs and encrypt, decrypt, sign, and verify messages locally.
- [Bcrypt Hash & Verify](https://tools.massadas.com/bcrypt/): Hash a password with bcrypt (adjustable cost) and verify a plaintext against any hash.
- [Certificate Decoder](https://tools.massadas.com/cert-decoder/): Decode PEM X.509 certificates or chains: subject, issuer, validity, fingerprints, SANs.
- [SVG to PNG](https://tools.massadas.com/svg-to-png/): Rasterize SVG markup or files to PNG, JPEG, or WebP at any scale or pixel size.
- [Favicon Generator](https://tools.massadas.com/favicon-generator/): Generate a complete favicon set (ICO, PNGs, manifest, HTML snippet) as a ZIP.
- [Color Palette Extractor](https://tools.massadas.com/color-palette/): Extract a color palette from any image; export as HEX/RGB, CSS variables, JSON, or Tailwind colors.
- [Image Cropper](https://tools.massadas.com/image-cropper/): Crop images with aspect presets, rotate/flip, resize, and export to PNG/JPEG/WebP.
- [ASCII Art Generator](https://tools.massadas.com/ascii-art/): Convert images to ASCII art, or generate ASCII block-letter banners from text.
- [CSV to Excel](https://tools.massadas.com/csv-xlsx/): Convert between CSV and Excel/ODS spreadsheets; preview sheets and download as CSV or XLSX.
- [Mermaid Editor](https://tools.massadas.com/mermaid-editor/): Write and live-preview Mermaid diagrams with examples and SVG/PNG export.
- [Invoice Generator](https://tools.massadas.com/invoice-generator/): Build invoices with live preview, line items, tax/discount, and PDF export.
- [JSONPath Playground](https://tools.massadas.com/jsonpath/): Run JSONPath and JMESPath queries against JSON with live results and a cheat sheet.
